title: Iran holds farewell ceremony for six martyrs killed in US strikes
text:
Iran holds farewell ceremony for six martyrs killed in US strikes"

"🔆🔅Aghajari city, Khuzestan province - September 2nd, A farewell ceremony was held on Wednesday evening for six martyrs who lost their lives in the US attacks on Iran's southwestern Khuzestan province."

"The ceremony took place at the Unknown Martyrs Memorial in Aghajari city, with the participation of families of the martyrs, veterans, officials, and large crowds of mourners."

"The six martyrs were identified as Mohammadreza Badram, Amirhossein Salimzadeh, Hamed Akati, Mojtaba Bagheri, Seyyed Malek Mousavi, and Hossein Mahdavian."

"The US missile strikes targeted multiple locations around the cities of Ahvaz and Aghajari in Khuzestan province. State media reported that seven people were martyred and eight others wounded in the attacks on three locations in the province."

"The funeral ceremony was held at 9 PM local time, with authorities calling on the public to pay tribute to the martyrs and renew their commitment to the ideals of the Islamic Revolution.
